verdict.rationale: The evidence lists RustDesk's capabilities (remote view and control, file transfer, clipboard file copy) and Server Pro's per-user and device-group access control. None of it documents scoping a session's permissions to view-only, control, clipboard, or file access. Device-level access control and a generic '90+ options' claim are adjacent features, not documented permission scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can scope what a connected device may do: view only, control, clipboard, or file access
